name: Snow Queen (CR 1)
body:
SNOW QUEEN CR 1

Human oracle 1 (spirit guide)/hierophant 1
NG Medium humanoid (human)
Init +1; Senses Perception +1

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 11, flat-footed 13 (+3 armor, +1 Dex)
hp 14 (1d8+2+4)
Fort +2; Ref +1; Will +3
Defensive Abilities hard to kill

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee quarterstaff +0 (1d6)
Special Attacks mythic power 5/day, surge +1d6
Oracle Spells Known (CL 1st, concentration +4)

1st Level (4/day)—cure light wounds, endure elements, ice armor
0-Level (at will)—detect magic, guidance, light, purify food and drink, read magic

Mystery Winter

STATISTICS

Str 10, Dex 13, Con 14, Int 12, Wis 13, Cha 17
Base Atk +0; CMB +0; CMD 11
Traits House of Green Mothers Pupil, Rich Parent
Feats Elemental Focus M (cold), Elemental Spell (cold)
Skills Diplomacy +7, Knowledge (nature) +5, Knowledge (nobility) +5, Knowledge (religion) +5, Perform (sing) +4, Survival +2
Languages Aquan, Common
SQ divine surge (inspired spell), oracle’s curse (reclusive), path ability (mythic domain), revelation (ice shape 6/day [15 cu. ft.])
Gear darkleaf cloth studded leather armor (775 gp), ice skates (1 gp), long gloves (15 gp), oracle’s kit (9 gp), quarterstaff, silver tiara (100 gp)
